projects.title: EduTrace
projects.summary: Full-stack educational tracking and academic achievement recording system.
projects.problem: Educational institutions struggle with fragmented student achievement tracking and unverifiable credential claims.
projects.solution: A centralized, verified educational tracking platform providing immutable records and accessible student dashboards.

projects.title: GDGOC E-Commerce
projects.summary: Modular, high-concurrency backend service implementing Clean Architecture for e-commerce transactions.
projects.problem: Traditional monolithic backends face maintainability bottlenecks and tight coupling under increasing transaction volumes.
projects.solution: Built a decoupled Go REST API with pure domain entities, repository pattern, and structured database transactions.

projects.title: Maritime AI Dashboard
projects.summary: Real-time vessel tracking and predictive monitoring system with intelligent maritime telemetry.
projects.problem: Port authorities and logistics operators lack unified visibility into vessel traffic patterns and anomalous route deviations.
projects.solution: Engineered an interactive dashboard providing automated telemetry visualization and route analysis.

projects.title: Smart Kitchen
projects.summary: Connected kitchen automation backend providing event processing and IoT device telemetry coordination.
projects.problem: Household culinary devices operate in silos without coordinated automation or centralized temperature safety monitoring.
projects.solution: Developed a resilient backend service handling asynchronous device events and status synchronization.
